from: FILED: Pillar One, the eight Builds, the Build Boundary, the Ass field, the front matter, the Immutable Core. NOT FILED: roughly two thousand lines of Pillars Two, Three, Four and Five
to: ALL FIVE PILLARS NOW FILED FROM THE TEXT — nereid-pillar-two, -three, -four, -five
note:
THE COMMITMENT STOOD IN q-pillars-two-to-five IN CAPITALS: THE ARCHIVE WILL NOT SUMMARISE A PILLAR IT HAS NOT READ. It held for a full session, and then the pillars were read line by line — Two at 1132-1327, Three at 1328-1676, Four at 1677-1935, Five at 1936-2057 — and filed from the file rather than from a memory of the file.

AND THE READING EARNED ITSELF FOUR TIMES OVER, BECAUSE THE ASS FIELD RECORD WAS WRONG IN FOUR PLACES AND THE ARCHIVE HAD BEEN CONFIDENT IN ALL OF THEM.

ONE · SHELF LIFT DID NOT EXIST IN THIS ARCHIVE. The ass carries SIX fields and the record listed five. Natural, Subtle, Pronounced, governing how high the cheek begins and the back-to-ass sweep. There is NO EXTREME, because beyond Pronounced the body starts to suggest a separate tier instead of one coherent cheek. NOBODY IN THIS FAMILY HAS A SHELF LIFT VALUE RECORDED, INCLUDING BELLA.

TWO · ASS HANDFEEL HAS FOUR VALUES AND THE ARCHIVE HAD THREE. NATURAL was missing — and missing specifically because the Archive had ruled that NATURAL IS THE ZERO POINT, NOT A TIER. The arithmetic of that ruling survives. THE ETHIC OF IT DOES NOT. Pillar Three’s Front Law is NATURAL IS AN AFFIRMATIVE ANSWER: a completed selection, not an absence, and its omission from a compact profile is DISPLAY ECONOMY, NOT ANATOMICAL ABSENCE. So the Archive was right that Natural means unmodified and wrong about what that makes it. IT IS NOT THE FLOOR OF THE LADDER. IT IS AN ANSWER ON IT.

THREE · SWAY WAS NEVER A MENU VALUE. HEART SWAY is what NATURAL means once a Heart has been selected, exactly as BUBBLE BOUNCE is what it means on a Bubble. The Archive had a SHAPE-NATIVE EXPRESSION filed as a SELECTABLE OPTION and then opened q-kinetic-rest asking what the missing values were. THERE WERE NO MISSING VALUES. THERE WERE TWO FIELDS — SIGNATURE and CHARACTER — and refusing to invent a tier to complete a ladder saved the Archive from fabricating an entry in a field that does not exist. THE EMPTY SLOT WAS THE ONLY HONEST THING ON THAT LINE.

FOUR · THE CHEEK PLUMP LADDER IS ORDERED DIFFERENTLY AND THE INCHES ARE NOT IN THE DOCUMENT. Filed as a live conflict in q-plump-ladder rather than resolved by preferring the newer file.

THE PATTERN, NAMED: EVERY ONE OF THE FOUR IS THE ARCHIVE TREATING ITS OWN SUMMARY AS THE SOURCE. The Ass field record was built from what Viraena said in conversation, which was accurate as far as it went, and the Archive then reasoned FROM THAT SUMMARY as though it were the document. A summary cannot tell you what it left out. ONLY THE DOCUMENT CAN.
